claims.claim: Sonya Skinner is one of two winners of the 2026 IPAC Established Leader Award.
claims.episode_span: one of two winners of the 2026 Institute of Public Administration of Canada Established Leader Award
claims.source_title: Collingwood’s CAO gets national leadership accolades
claims.supporting_quote: Collingwood's CAO Sonya Skinner was one of two winners of this year's Institute of Public Administration Canada's Established Leader Award.

claims.claim: The award was presented at IPAC's National Public Service Symposium in Ottawa on October 7, and Skinner was selected from a shortlist of seven.
claims.episode_span: presented at IPAC's National Public Service Symposium in Ottawa on October 7, and Skinner was chosen from a national shortlist of seven
claims.source_title: Collingwood CAO Sonya Skinner Receives National Public Service Award
claims.supporting_quote: The award was presented during IPAC's National Public Service Symposium in Ottawa on Oct. 7.

claims.claim: Skinner has been Collingwood's CAO since 2020 and previously held senior roles with the Grey Sauble Conservation Authority and the Ontario Public Service.
claims.episode_span: She has been Collingwood's CAO since 2020, after more than two decades in executive and board roles that included the Grey Sauble Conservation Authority and the Ontario Public Service
claims.source_title: Collingwood CAO Sonya Skinner Receives National Public Service Award
claims.supporting_quote: Skinner, who has served as Collingwood's CAO since 2020, was selected from a national shortlist of seven nominees representing public-sector organizations from across Canada.

claims.claim: A 33-year-old Wasaga Beach resident was charged after OPP and Peel Regional Police executed a search warrant on June 23 and seized electronic devices; the accused was arrested September 12 and is due in court October 27.
claims.episode_span: executed a search warrant at a Wasaga Beach home on June 23 and seized several electronic devices
claims.source_title: Wasaga Beach Resident Charged in Child Exploitation Investigation
claims.supporting_quote: The Ontario Provincial Police Child Sexual Exploitation Unit, with assistance from Peel Regional Police, executed a search warrant at a Wasaga Beach home on June 23 and seized several electronic devices.

claims.claim: The accused is charged with two counts of possession of child sexual abuse and exploitation material, one count each of making and accessing that material, and one count of voyeurism.

claims.claim: Kevin McNab was the sole recipient of the 2026 Richard Armstrong Leadership Award, presented in Niagara Falls earlier in October, and Grey County council recognized him on October 22.
claims.episode_span: Kevin McNab is the sole recipient of the 2026 Richard Armstrong Leadership Award
claims.source_title: Grey County Paramedic Chief earns provincial leadership award
claims.supporting_quote: Grey County recognized Paramedic Chief Kevin McNab Thursday, after he was named the sole recipient of the 2026 Richard Armstrong Leadership Award during the annual gathering of the Ontario Association of Paramedic Chiefs (OAPC) in Niagara Falls earlier this month.

claims.claim: McNab has served Grey County more than 30 years, including nine as chief, grew community paramedicine from a pilot that aids hundreds with chronic illness, secured provincial grants, and the service has more than 160 paramedics and staff.
claims.episode_span: more than 30 years, including nine years as paramedic chief
claims.source_title: Grey County Paramedic Chief Kevin McNab Wins Provincial Leadership Award
claims.supporting_quote: McNab has worked for Grey County for more than 30 years, including nine as paramedic chief.

claims.claim: Warden Andrea Matrosovs said McNab's leadership has had a profound impact on healthcare in Grey County and beyond.
claims.episode_span: Andrea Matrosovs said McNab's leadership has had a profound impact on healthcare in Grey County and beyond
claims.source_title: Grey County Paramedic Chief earns provincial leadership award
claims.supporting_quote: “Kevin's leadership has had a profound impact on healthcare in Grey County and beyond,” said Grey County Warden Andrea Matrosovs.
